name: load_trace_for_analysis
description: Load a Perfetto trace file into the trace processor for SQL queries and analysis. After loading, use run_sql_query to query the trace data. Use trace_path to load from a specific file path, or session_id to load from the traces directory. If both are omitted, loads the most recently captured trace.

session_id.description: The file name of the trace (session ID). If omitted, uses the most recently captured trace. Ignored if trace_path is provided.

trace_path.description: Full path to a .pftrace or .ptrace file. If provided, loads from this exact path instead of looking in the traces directory.
